name: Salmon & Duck Complete Pet Food
description: Slow-cooked wild Alaskan salmon paired with heritage duck breast, infused with cranberries, pumpkin, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil for optimal coat luster and cellular vitality.
overview: A complete dry-food formula built around salmon and duck, with pumpkin and cranberries for a balanced everyday meal.
bestFor: Adult dogs and cats needing a protein-forward everyday dry food.
serving: Introduce gradually over 7 days. Follow the feeding guidance on the package and adjust portions for body size, age, activity, and veterinary recommendations.
care: Store sealed in a cool, dry place. Keep fresh water available at all times.
notes: This product page uses the recipe information in the FurEver Care catalog. Feeding amounts should be individualized by a veterinarian when a pet has a medical condition.

name: Orthopedic Memory Foam Pet Bed
description: Handcrafted orthopedic dual-layer memory foam encased in stain-resistant burgundy velvet with removable, machine-washable hypoallergenic upholstery.
overview: A supportive pet bed with a dual-layer foam core and removable velvet cover, designed for daily rest and easy cleaning.
bestFor: Dogs and cats that prefer a supportive sleeping surface, including older or less-active pets.
serving: Place the bed on a flat, dry indoor surface with enough room for your pet to stretch and turn comfortably.
care: Remove the cover before washing and follow the garment-care instructions. Spot-clean the inner components and allow them to dry completely.
notes: Choose a size that allows your pet to lie fully extended without hanging over the edges.

name: Botanical Coat Conditioning Wash
description: pH-balanced botanical conditioning shampoo formulated with pure damask rosewater, silk amino acids, and soothing chamomile extract to restore natural sheen.
overview: A botanical cleansing and conditioning wash combining rose hydrosol, aloe, chamomile, silk amino acids, and jojoba oil for routine coat care.
bestFor: Dogs and cats that need a gentle bathing routine and a conditioned, soft-feeling coat.
serving: Wet the coat thoroughly, work a small amount through the fur, avoid the eyes and inner ears, then rinse completely.
specifications: Rose, aloe, chamomile, silk, and jojoba blend
care: Keep container closed between uses and store at room temperature away from direct heat and sunlight.
notes: For pets with persistent itching, redness, sores, or other skin concerns, seek veterinary advice rather than relying on a cosmetic wash.

name: Probiotic & Joint Support Chews
description: Clinical-grade microencapsulated probiotics (10 Billion CFU) combined with marine collagen peptides and green-lipped mussel for joint lubrication and gut health.
overview: Chewable support combining marine collagen, green-lipped mussel, probiotics, glucosamine, and turmeric in a convenient daily format.
bestFor: Adult dogs whose guardians are looking for nutritional joint and digestive support.
serving: Use according to the package directions and your pet's weight. Introduce gradually if your pet is not accustomed to supplements.
care: Keep tightly closed in a cool, dry place. Do not exceed the labeled serving without veterinary guidance.
notes: Supplements are not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment. Ask a veterinarian before use for pets taking medication or managing a health condition.

name: Full-Grain Leather Leash & Collar
description: Vegetable-tanned full-grain Italian leather in deep burgundy with solid brushed brass hardware and reinforced saddle stitching for effortless strolls.
overview: A coordinated walking set made from full-grain leather with brass hardware and reinforced stitching for everyday leash-and-collar use.
bestFor: Dogs that need a durable collar and leash set for supervised walks.
serving: Adjust the collar so two fingers can fit comfortably between the collar and your dog's neck. Attach the leash to a secure collar ring.
care: Wipe leather with a soft, slightly damp cloth and allow it to air-dry naturally. Keep leather away from prolonged water exposure.
notes: Inspect stitching, hardware, collar fit, and leash attachment points before every walk. Replace any worn component.

name: Sisal & Wood Cat Activity Tower
description: Sculptural architectural cat enrichment tower crafted from sustainably harvested teakwood and natural unbleached sisal rope with a cushioned observation perch.
overview: A multi-level indoor cat tower combining a sturdy wooden structure, sisal surfaces, and an elevated cushioned perch for climbing and resting.
bestFor: Indoor cats that enjoy climbing, scratching, observing, and changing resting positions.
serving: Assemble on a level floor and position away from unstable furniture or narrow walkways. Introduce the tower with treats or familiar bedding if needed.
care: Vacuum loose fur and debris regularly. Wipe wooden surfaces with a lightly damp cloth and keep the tower dry.
notes: Check fasteners and structural stability regularly, especially after moving or reassembling the tower.

name: Freeze-Dried Venison Training Treats
description: 100% pasture-raised New Zealand venison freeze-dried at peak nutrient density, tossed with antioxidant-rich hand-harvested lingonberries.
overview: Single-protein freeze-dried venison treats made for small rewards during training, with a short ingredient list centered on venison.
bestFor: Training sessions where a small, high-value reward is useful for dogs or cats.
serving: Break larger pieces into training-size portions and count treats as part of the day's overall food intake.
care: Reseal after opening and store according to the package directions. Keep treats dry and use clean hands or utensils.
notes: Introduce any new treat gradually and monitor your pet for digestive sensitivity.

name: Quiet Ceramic Pet Water Fountain
description: Heavy glazed ceramic drinking fountain with quadruple coconut carbon filtration and ultra-silent submersible pump to encourage natural hydration habits.
overview: A glazed ceramic drinking fountain with a 2.2-liter reservoir, carbon filtration, and a quiet submersible pump to keep water moving.
bestFor: Dogs and cats that benefit from a circulating water source at home.
serving: Fill with fresh water to the recommended level, position on a stable surface, and replace the filter on the manufacturer's schedule.
care: Unplug before cleaning. Wash the basin regularly, clean the pump according to its care instructions, and replace the filter as needed.
notes: Always keep a clean alternative water source available if the fountain is unplugged or being cleaned.

name: Natural Rubber Puzzle Ball
description: Ergonomically textured non-toxic natural rubber puzzle feeder designed to reward patience, slow down fast eaters, and provide stimulating mental exercise.
overview: A textured natural-rubber puzzle ball that can hold small food rewards, turning mealtime or training into a simple enrichment activity.
bestFor: Dogs and cats that enjoy food-motivated puzzle play and supervised enrichment.
serving: Use with appropriately sized dry treats or kibble. Start with an easy fill level, then increase difficulty as your pet learns the toy.
care: Wash after use with mild soap and water, rinse thoroughly, and allow the toy to dry completely.
notes: Use only under supervision and remove the toy if it becomes damaged or small pieces begin to separate.

name: Herbal Calming Support Drops
description: Veterinarian-formulated liquid adaptogen elixir containing organic KSM-66 Ashwagandha, passionflower, and L-theanine for separation anxiety, grooming, and travel calm.
overview: A liquid botanical support blend featuring ashwagandha, passionflower, and L-theanine in an MCT oil carrier for use as a supplemental wellness product.
bestFor: Pet guardians considering a calming-support supplement and seeking professional guidance on suitability.
serving: Use only according to the product label and veterinary guidance. Do not estimate a dose from another animal or product.
care: Store tightly closed as directed on the label and keep out of reach of children and pets when not in use.
notes: Herbal supplements can interact with medications and may not be appropriate for every pet. Consult a veterinarian before use, especially for pets with ongoing medical care.
